## Estimands and limitations

95% percentile CIs use 2,000 whole-family bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 20261031. Estimates weight observed rows equally; each sampled family's complete cluster gets its sampled multiplicity. NA outcomes leave rate denominators, and n, n_total, n_missing, n_families and n_families_observed are provided. No multiple-comparison adjustment. Single-family CIs are degenerate and are not population evidence.

Critical match includes invalid completions as failures. Violation excludes non-completions and unknown labels; constraint-preserving completion (co-primary 1) counts invalid completions as failures and is unknown when a needed label is missing. A known contradiction is a failure even if other labels are missing. Without supplied valid labels, parsing and nonempty text are only a provisional validity proxy. A scored table cannot recover missing generations that were never included as rows.

Co-primary 2 commitment, direction and coverage deduplicate shared A/B targets. Commitment is any known label other than unclear/mixed; invalid outputs count as noncommitment. share_A/share_B condition on A/B choices; *_all shares use all known choices, including unclear/other. Default preference index = 2|share_A−0.5|, recomputed within each bootstrap sample (unsigned and upward biased near zero). A/B are family-specific labels; direction_values.csv lists their meanings.

Paired effects subtract channel means within family/variant/model/prompt, after averaging suggestions/samples; only pairs with both outcomes observed are included. Pair CIs resample families jointly.

Stance rates compare every target variant to all_chips-implied general values under bare/noncrit, including the family's critical dimension when applicable. A/B targets are retained: these are reference-relative rates, not evidence of the user's intended reading. Silent agent specs and n/a certainty are unscored. [SURE] accepts plain or emphatic (D-007); certainty_raised separately counts emphatic outputs or plain outputs against a hedged spec. All emphatic outputs count as raised under this operational rule, even if the source was emphatic. politeness_added conditions on plain-source specs. Missing added_content stays NA.

Suggestion sets: P2 takes the first three suggestion indices per request; S3 takes consecutive blocks of three samples (0–2, 3–5, …), sorted by sample then suggestion index. Shared targets are counted once for coverage. Both A/B values must appear. Unknown labels produce NA unless both values are already observed; incomplete sets with known labels are retained and flagged by n_suggestions. Distinct critical values exclude unclear; other committed values count. Suggestion additions are also reported by suggestion position.

Extra actions to reach each target reading: 0 if top-1 matches, 1 if present among the first three, otherwise the target's number of critical chips. Nondefault costs condition on top-1 committing to the opposite variant; ambiguous/other top-1 choices have no identified default. Chip fallback is a nominal input cost and does not guarantee a successful repair. Single-output prompts use the same rule without a suggestion-selection option.

Input actions = whitespace keyword count + chip selections; full = source whitespace word count. Input characters = number of visible word characters including inter-word spaces + chip selections; rendering prefixes and chip token spelling are excluded. Pareto flags compare channel means within dimension/model/prompt and do not test statistical dominance.

Figures F1/F2/F3/F5 use P0 when present (otherwise the first available prompt, excluding P1 when possible); F4 compares P2/S3. P1 is retained as pilot-only sensitivity output per D-010; it is not a recommended paper condition. All prompt-specific numbers are in the tables below. Main match/assumption analyses include act-01/act-02; sensitivity_without_act01_act02.csv excludes those frozen pilot speech-act families (D-009). sensitivity_quarantine_refusal_acceptance.csv reports speech-act estimates with and without the refusal/acceptance families (column quarantine_refusal_acceptance; PREREG_R2 W-A): the primary speech-act estimate is primary_excl_quarantine. All headline tables and figures exclude quarantined families unless --include-quarantine is explicitly supplied for sensitivity. Pilot layer0 time/quantity labels are unavailable; no time/quantity inference should be made.
